title: Fine rates
subtitle: What a customer is charged for an overdue installment. Rates can differ by category (plots, flats, villas, shops). The most specific rate wins: customer, then property, then project, then the default.

hint.default: Applies wherever no project, property or customer rate is set.
hint.project: Applies to every property in the project unless a category or property rate overrides it.
hint.unit: Applies to this property unless its customer has a specific rate.
hint.customer: Applies to everything this customer owns, ahead of property and project rates. Set a category rate to price shops and plots differently for this customer.

card.isDefault: Used wherever nothing more specific is set.
card.custom: A rate set here for this level.
card.clearMessage: Fines on overdue invoices are recalculated with the rate this level inherits.
card.saved: Fine rate saved. Overdue fines were recalculated.
card.cleared: Specific rate removed. Overdue fines were recalculated.

title.project: Set a fine rate for this project
title.unit: Set a fine rate for this property
title.customer: Set a fine rate for this customer

form.percentHint: 0 to 100, up to two decimals. Charged on the installment amount.
form.amountHint: Charged once for each overdue installment.

table.label: Specific fine rates
table.removeMessage: Remove the specific rate for {{name}}? Overdue fines are recalculated with the rate it inherits.
table.emptyBody: Everything uses the default rate. Set a rate on a project, property or customer page.

categories.hint: Give plots, flats, villas or shops their own rate. A category without one uses the rate for all categories.
